capabilities: Run HTML/CSS/JS app folders in sandboxed tabs or embedded blocks
Grant apps scoped read, write and listing permissions via manifest.json
Log, review and undo app writes using snapshots
Configure exclusions, network allow-lists and trusted apps
disambiguation: Not an HTML editor or code playground; it runs self-contained app folders that interact with your notes through a scoped bridge.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; not yet on the community list, so install is manual or via BRAT. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; works on desktop and mobile. Detailed security and privacy policies live in separate docs (security.md, bridge API reference).
problem: Obsidian can display HTML but offers no safe way for small self-contained web apps to read and modify notes without unrestricted vault access.
summary: Sandboxed runner for HTML, CSS and JavaScript app folders in your vault, letting apps read and edit notes only through a permission-checked bridge.
